amendment_policy: Any change to order, edge, 15 pp threshold, signed/absolute gap, Stage 3 disagreement rule, or missing-value semantics requires a new explicit contract version (for example V2); V1 is immutable.
classification_effect: RESEARCH_CONSIDERATION_EXCLUSIONS only; predictions remain generated, exported, immutable and gradeable; no production authority changes.

discovery_window.population: finalized HGB Points x retained market evidence

missing_value_semantics.edge: EDGE_UNAVAILABLE; retain in Stage 1; continue to later screens if their inputs are available
missing_value_semantics.gap: GAP_UNAVAILABLE; do not exclude at Stage 2; continue to Stage 3 if sides are available
missing_value_semantics.side: SIDE_UNAVAILABLE; do not exclude at Stage 3

stage_0.name: ALL_MARKET_USABLE_PREDICTIONS
stage_0.population: Pregame HGB prediction matched to legitimate two-sided retained Points market evidence.

stage_1.discovery_rationale: NONCOMPETITIVE_FOR_CONSIDERATION; not a validated failure region.
stage_1.edge_definition: Selected model-side probability minus raw American implied probability calculated from that side's separately aggregated median attachment price; raw probability includes vig.
stage_1.missing: EDGE_UNAVAILABLE remains classified and is not silently excluded.
stage_1.name: RESEARCH_EXCLUDE_NEGATIVE_EDGE
stage_1.rule: Exclude only when selected-side production edge < 0.

diagnostic_cohorts.OPPOSITE_SIDE: model side differs from no-vig market side
diagnostic_cohorts.SAME_SIDE_CONFIDENCE_DISAGREEMENT: model side equals no-vig market side within Stage 2; the >15pp signed selected-side gap is the confidence disagreement

stage_2.gap: Signed positive selected-side probability gap; no absolute value. Strict > 0.15 (15 percentage points).
stage_2.missing: Unavailable gap is retained and separately identifiable; it is not treated as exceeding threshold.
stage_2.name: RESEARCH_EXCLUDE_EXTREME_MODEL_MARKET_GAP
stage_2.no_vig_market: Convert both side median American prices to raw implied probabilities, normalize each by their two-side sum, then select probability for the model-selected side.
stage_2.rule: Among Stage 1 survivors, exclude only when selected_side_model_probability - selected_side_no_vig_market_probability > 0.15.

stage_3.market_side: OVER when normalized no-vig p_over >= 0.5, otherwise UNDER.
stage_3.model_side: OVER when model p_over >= 0.5, otherwise UNDER.
stage_3.name: PROVISIONAL_STAGE_3_OPPOSITE_SIDE_DISAGREEMENT
stage_3.rule: Among Stage 2 survivors only, exclude when model_side != market_side.
stage_3.status: Provisional, independently evaluated, not merged into Stage 2.

validation_gate.assessment: directional consistency, material excess-loss reduction, acceptable wins sacrificed, no single-date domination, sufficient sample; no automatic production promotion
